hook: This baby was 15 months old when the flood came.
narration: This baby was just fifteen months old when the flood came.
Floodwater had swallowed the whole neighborhood in South Carolina.
The baby and mom were trapped inside a house like this one.
A Coast Guard helicopter came in low over the rooftops, and the crew got the hoist ready.
outcome: Then they pulled both of them up into the helicopter.
title: Trapped by floodwater with her baby
description:
Severe flooding inundated a neighborhood in Huger, South Carolina, on Oct. 4, 2015. A Coast Guard helicopter crew rescued a mother and her 15-month-old infant from their flooded house.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/426559
